stem.text: A single horizontal force $F$ is applied to a block X which is in contact with a separate block Y, as shown.

stem.alt: Line drawing of two adjacent rectangular blocks labelled X and Y on a horizontal surface, with a horizontal arrow labelled F pointing towards block X.

stem.text: The blocks remain in contact as they accelerate along a horizontal frictionless surface. Air resistance is negligible. X has a greater mass than Y.

A.text: The acceleration of X is equal to force $F$ divided by the mass of X.

B.text: The force that X exerts on Y is equal to $F$.

C.text: The force that X exerts on Y is less than $F$.

D.text: The force that X exerts on Y is less than the force that Y exerts on X.
